values: 一位疯狂的射手，能够召唤使徒协助自己摧毁敌人。
A trigger-happy Marksman who calls on apostles to help him tear through the enemy.
Come and play with me for a while!
啧……有点无聊。去找点有趣的事做吧！
This is getting boring. Let's go find something fun to do!
找谁陪小爷去四处逛逛……就你了。
Who will accompany me for a stroll around... You!
Not bad. This will help pass the time.
The lives of mortals are truly dull.
Eating? What a waste of time!
不要轻易向拉曼提斯提出挑战。一旦他产生兴趣，就会将身边的人全部拖入他那近乎于疯狂的战斗中。
Do not challenge Lamentis unless you are ready for the consequences. Once he gets excited, he will turn it into a relentless brawl and drag everyone nearby into it.
拉曼提斯难以忍受长篇大论的对话。绝大多数情况，在对话结束前，他就已经忍不住动手了。
Lamentis has no patience for long speeches. Most of the time, he starts swinging before the other person even gets to the point.
拉曼提斯飞行的速度非常快，顷刻之间就能穿梭数百里。代价是每次飞行后他都需要休息很久进行恢复。
Lamentis flies terrifyingly fast, crossing hundreds of miles in moments. The price is that every flight leaves him in need of a long rest.
拉曼提斯喜欢在伊索米亚四处闲逛。对于那些只愿意停留在某处不动弹的恶魔同僚，他表示不屑一顾。
Lamentis loves roaming across Esperia. He has very little respect for Hypogeans who are content to sit in one place forever.
当拉曼提斯的大脑实在太过混乱，无法继续思考时，他会选择在原地睡一觉。
When Lamentis' head gets too crowded to think straight, he simply lies down and sleeps it off.
不仅是半神，不少恶魔也对拉曼提斯顽劣叛逆、喜怒无常的性格感到头疼。
It's not only the Celestials who find Lamentis exhausting. Plenty of Hypogeans also struggle with his rebellious streak and wild temper.
“我只是邀请他去看场有趣的戏，他居然把我精心准备好的戏台炸了！”，一位不愿透露姓名的恶魔如此控诉。
"I merely invited him to watch a show, and he blew up the stage I had so carefully prepared!" —A Hypogean who wisely chose to remain unnamed
拉曼提斯做事缺乏耐心，一旦失去兴趣，就会立刻转身离开。至于后续可能造成的混乱，就不在他的考虑范围内了。
Lamentis has very little patience for anything that bores him. The moment he loses interest, he leaves. Whatever chaos follows is, in his view, someone else's problem.
拉曼提斯很喜欢看星星。繁星众多的夜晚，是他少有的平静时刻。
Lamentis loves watching the stars. On nights when the sky is full of them, he becomes unusually quiet.
对于拉曼提斯而言，无论是半神、恶魔还是凡人，都没有任何区别。他只在意自己是不是被人惹怒。
Lamentis doesn't care whether someone is a Celestial, a Hypogean, or a human. Once they annoy him, they are all treated the same.
拉曼提斯！那座小城可是我精心准备了整整半个月的绝佳剧场！
Lamentis! Do you have any idea how much work went into that city?!
Eating? What a waste of time!
